description: This file defines the ReturnReason controller class for the Opencart admin localization module, managing CRUD operations for return reasons including listing, form rendering, saving, and deleting return reason entries.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Controller class for managing return reasons in the admin panel's localisation section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main list view for return reasons, setting up breadcrumbs, page titles, and loading sub-views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of return reasons, primarily delegating to getList for output.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches return reason data with pagination, prepares the data array for the list view, and returns rendered HTML.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form to add or edit a return reason, including language-specific descriptions and navigation links.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submissions for creating or updating a return reason, returns JSON response with success or error messages.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles bulk deletion of return reasons, with permission checks and validation to prevent deletion if associated with existing returns.
